Title: CORSAIR DOMINATOR TITANIUM vs DOMINATOR PLATINUM
URL: https://www.corsair.com/us/en/explorer/diy-builder/memory/corsair-dominator-titanium-vs-platinum/
Published: 2023-09-26T13:05:05.000Z
Author: Corsair Gaming
Highlights:
So, when the DDR5 memory standard was unleashed back in 2020, we released our top of the line DRAM modules to take advantage of the benefits of the new standard. Since then, the DDR5 standard has undergone some important changes, so it was time for a new flagship: enter DOMINATOR TITANIUM.

...

For starters, we've added a diffusion layer over the LEDs, creating a more even spread of illumination. This allows all 16.4m colors in the RGB spectrum to shine through and glow, instead of visibly separate LEDs. (Don’t worry, each LED is still individually addressable, so any animated lighting settings you’ve grown fond of will still work.) The light shines out from the top and through two slots on each side, so the DRAM looks great regardless of system configuration, so the more creative and experimental builders out there still get to enjoy the light show.

...

In addition to allowing you to swap the top bars, removing them provides another advantage—a reduction in height. If you’re a fan of small form-factor builds or simply have an overly large air cooler, tall DRAM modules can be a problem. Removing the top bars of DOMINATOR TITANIUM allows you to remove almost a 3rd of the total height.

...

The most influential aspect of performance upgraded in with the DOMINATOR TITANIUM DDR5 DRAM is the transfer rate. Where previous revisions of our DRAM topped out at 6,800MT/s (Mega-transfers per second,) DOMINATOR TITANIUM kits are available in speeds up to 8,000MT/s. This is a significant increase in power, which is particularly useful for gaming. Though you shouldn’t take our word for it, we got the folks over at Digital Foundry to do some testing. You can read the full Memory Matters article for more info, but the gist of it is that you can expect as much as a 31% increase in average frames per second when compared to comparable DDR4.

## DOMINATOR TITANIUM vs DOMINATOR PLATINUM: Which is the best?

In terms of performance, design, and customizability, CORSAIR DOMINATOR TITANIUM DRAM is significantly more advanced than CORSAIR DOMINATOR PLATINUM DDR5. It's worth bearing in mind that you'll need to have a fairly up-to-date machine to be able to take advantage of DOMINATOR TITANIUM though, as it’s only available as DDR5. If your PC is a little older, you'll need to make sure your motherboard and CPU are DDR5 compatibility. If you’re good to go for DDR5, DOMINATOR TITANIUM is the way forward. Otherwise, our DOMINATOR PLATINUM and VENGEANCE line-up has you covered for DDR4.

---

Title: CORSAIR Memory Explained: VENGEANCE, DOMINATOR TITANIUM And PLATINUM | CORSAIR
URL: https://www.corsair.com/us/en/explorer/diy-builder/memory/corsair-memory-explained-vengeance-dominator-titanium-and-platinum/
Published: 2025-07-28T13:37:02.000Z
Author: Corsair Gaming
Highlights:
At time of writing, CORSAIR sells two types of memory; DDR4 and DDR5. Within those two memory types are two families of memory based on performance and features; VENGEANCE and DOMINATOR. Once you dive into those memory families there are an additional two types:

DDR5

- VENGEANCE
- VENGEANCE RGB
- DOMINATOR PLATINUM
- DOMINATOR TITANIUM

DDR4

- VENGEANCE
- VENGEANCE RGB Pro SL
- VENGEANCE RGB Pro
- DOMINATOR PLATINUM RGB

Each type of memory is notably different from the others, so here's how they all stack up to each other.

...

### CORSAIR VENGEANCE DDR5

This is standard high-quality memory with no RGB and a low profile, making it ideal for blackout builds and systems with a tall CPU air cooler where the fan might interfere with a RAM stick in slot #1. This is affordable, mainstream, high-performance, no-bling memory for any PC build.

...

### CORSAIR VENGEANCE RGB DDR5

This memory is the same as “regular” VENGEANCE so it also includes onboard voltage regulation but it offers slightly higher performance options and sports addressable 10-zone RGB lighting. Its RGB light bars are a bit taller than the non-RGB version, so it’s best for use on systems with all-in-one liquid CPU coolers as those won’t interfere with RAM clearance due to the compact size of the water block/pump assembly.

...

### CORSAIR DOMINATOR PLATINUM DDR5

Now we are moving into a premium category of RAM with onboard voltage regulation, hand-tested modules, sophisticated cooling and design, and elaborate RGB lighting. DOMINATOR PLATINUM is memory made for running at high clock speeds with low temps, featuring premium craftsmanship and unique lighting.

...

### CORSAIR DOMINATOR TITANIUM DDR5

This is CORSAIR’s flagship memory, with onboard voltage regulation, high clocks, sophisticated aesthetics, superior cooling, and the ability to customize the RGB lighting with removable light bars. This memory is for PC builders who want the best memory CORSAIR has to offer for top-tier builds with a refined look that’s not super flashy, but more on the classy side.

CORSAIR DOMINATOR TITANIUM DDR5

Standout features include:

- Premium craftsmanship and construction
- Modular light bars
- 3D-Printable light bars

...

- Customizable Intel XMP profiles
- Available in black, white, and grey

These memory sticks are all hand-tested for consistently high clock speeds and stable operation, and are offered in speeds ranging from DDR5-6000 to DDR5-7600 in capacities ranging from 32GB to 96GB. They are not offered in CUDIMM versions. They are available with AMD EXPO and Intel XMP one-click overclocking, and XMP profiles can be customized as well.

...

## DDR4 Memory

Most of our DDR4 memory is at end-of-life status currently, as the computing world has largely moved on to DDR5, and a lot of memory manufacturers are no longer making new DDR4 memory modules. We are still selling DDR4 but have sold out of our high-end inventory as those customers have also moved onto DDR5 as well. As this is being written in July 2025, our DDR4 stock is rapidly depleting, so if you read this in the future and we no longer have any DDR4 memory for sale, it should not be a surprise.

### VENGEANCE DDR4

CORSAIR VENGEANCE DDR4

Like the DDR5 variant, this is our mainstream offering without RGB, so this is high-quality memory with a low-profile design that is perfect for air-cooled builds since it won’t get in the way of a fan extending over the first DIMM slot.

This memory is offered in speeds ranging from DDR4-2133 to DDR4-4000, and is compatible with both AMD and Intel systems. Available capacities range from 8GB to 128GB.

...

It features 10-zone RGB lighting with LEDs sprinkled throughout a one-piece top bar. It’s available in speeds ranging from DDR4-3200 to DDR4-4000 in capacities from 16GB to 128GB.

### VENGEANCE RGB PRO DDR4

CORSAIR VENGEANCE RGB PRO DDR4

This memory is essentially CORSAIR’s mainstream RGB DDR4 offering, with standard RAM height and a snazzy lightbar across the top for RGB lighting. These would be the sticks to get if you’re running an all-in-one (AIO) liquid CPU cooler.

It’s offered in more sizes and speeds than its smaller SL counterpart, with speeds ranging from DDR4-2666 to DDR4-4000, and capacities going from a mere 8GB all the way up to 128GB.

### CORSAIR DOMINATOR PLATINUM RGB DDR4 (EOL)

This memory is no longer being sold, but it was CORSAIR’s flagship DDR4 memory, with hand-tested memory chips guaranteed to run at tight timings and featuring a high-quality aluminum housing for a sleek look and better heat dissipation. It can be overclocked to DDR5 speeds of DDR4-4800, so it is made for those with a thirst for adventure.

This memory features CAPELLIX LED lighting for unique RGB lighting visible from the sides and the top and came in speeds ranging from DDR4-3200 to DDR4-4000. Available capacities ranged from 16GB to 64GB.

---

Title: Corsair Dominator Platinum RGB DDR5-6600 C32 Review: Cutting-Edge Performance | Tom's Hardware
URL: https://www.tomshardware.com/reviews/corsair-dominator-platinum-rgb-ddr5-6600-c32-review
Published: 2022-07-29T13:00:07.000Z
Author: Reviews By Zhiye Liu
Highlights:
The Dominator Platinum RGB memory modules feature an all-black, anodized heat spreader manufactured from aluminum. It's a great color choice since black blends in with any PC build. The memory modules measure 56mm (2.2 inches) in height, so clearance space shouldn't be a problem unless your CPU cooler is extremely large.

...

The memory kit has a capacity of 32GB, consisting of two 16GB DDR5 memory modules with a single-rank design. Therefore, it isn't surprising that the Dominator Platinum RGB memory modules use SK hynix's H5CG48MEBDX014 (M-die) integrated circuits (ICs), a popular choice for speedy DDR5 memory kits. Unfortunately, the power management IC (PMIC) only carries a "0D=9B J1V" marking. Nonetheless, dumping the SPD via CPU-Z reveals that Richtek manufactures this specific PMIC.
